address: 55/15 Mu 1, Phet Kasem Road, Lam Kaen, Thai Mueang, Phang-Nga, 82210, Thailand
bio: Basic furnishings and modest dish presentations belie the skill behind their precisely cooked recipes, which are made to order. Specialising in authentic Southern Thai seafood, they source the day's catch for dishes such as red grouper with bitter melon, and simple stir-fried melinjo leaves with fresh prawns. Their home-made curries use local Phang-nga ingredients. The wall of celebrity photos attests to its popularity....
